cards.title: Central discovers, UCS Manager collects
items: Central answers two questions only: which domains are registered (computeSystem) and which profiles exist (lsServer) — ADR-0014
A domain Central lists no profiles for is always collected; a domain with no address is a fault, exit 3 — docs/cisco-collectors.md, The pruning rules
Live run 2026-08-18: 152 registered domains, ~3,346 servers, every profile global-controlled — ADR-0014

cards.title: What UCSPE 4.2(2aS9) proved
items: A blade's own mgmtIf reports access='unspecified'; the out-of-band filter matched only fabric interconnects, so BMC selection is by DN position — ADR-0009
UCSPE reports 00:00:00:00:00:00 for blade CIMC MACs; normalize_mac drops it — ADR-0009
Site is the BMC IP prefix first, then the name, then the profile's org DN — ADR-0057

cards.title: Failure is contained per domain and per server
items: A failed domain keeps the servers read before it and records a collection error; a server that fails to map becomes a reachable=False COLLECTION_ERROR stub (needs a real serial, else only logged) — ADR-0062
Domains stream with asyncio.as_completed, so a killed run keeps what finished; early close drains so every domain logs out — ADR-0014, docs/cisco-collectors.md, Sessions
Exit 0 complete, 1 systemic (5+ servers and over 20% failed), 2 not configured, 3 partial — tools/run_collector.py

cards.title: RAID, cadence, BMCs
items: storageController + storageVirtualDrive feed the RAID verdict (ADR-0048); a degraded virtual drive raises raid.volume_degraded (MAJOR) or raid.volume_failed (CRITICAL); a missing disk (a lost mirror leg) raises raid.drive_missing (CRITICAL) — ADR-0068, UCS only
Cisco BMCs sit behind fabric interconnects and are not probed; Central and each domain report their own state (ADR-0037)
